review_notes: Display equations, inline expressions and tables transcribed from rendered source pages; exact counts and page lists are recorded above. Text outside these exact spans is unchanged. All 54 pages were textually compared, with individually rendered formula/table review and remaining layouts inspected in contact sheets. Not a claim of line-by-line visual prose review or independent legal approval.

Table 2 retains the printed slash/multiplication sequence and unmatched ordinary parentheses, not a silently corrected Black-Scholes fraction. Sigma squared has no i subscript in the source numerator.
The source PDF encodes its printed CDF symbol as Cyrillic U+0444 (ф), including its definition. Preserve it rather than silently replacing it with Greek phi.
Table 1 preserves printed 1.25 and 5,5 punctuation. OCR is only a draft: its prose and mathematical normalization were not automatically accepted.
The page-28 private-use summation is restored with its printed min(1 year; maturity) upper bound and delta-t weights. The RV summation indices split onto page 24 are joined to the page-23 equation.
Table 3 retains blank correlation cells for interest-rate and FX classes; blank is not a fabricated zero. Page 21 retains D_j in the FX equation despite i-indexed operands.

High-resolution source crops confirm upper-case K and J in the commodity T term, lower-case k in D_k, and a printed euro sign rather than set-membership on page 26. These source inconsistencies are retained, not silently repaired as mathematics.

The page-29 BRT definition omits its article number in print; preserve the omission. Page 46 prints baseline SMKT and RTi, unlike subsequent subscripted notation; preserve that too. Table 4's merged final-row percentages are repeated across the two covered columns.

Twelve prose/definition spans are restored to PDF reading order with exact token-multiset equality before/after. A stray standalone D absent from the printed page-28 paragraph is removed. The separate full-source audit accounts for every differing token span.
No registry, extraction provenance, signed seed or active release changes.
